info.title: v2.order.get_buyer_invoice_info
info.description: API to obtain buyer submitted invoice info for VN, TH and PH local sellers only.

post.description: API to obtain buyer submitted invoice info for VN, TH and PH local sellers only.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: order_sn
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.uat.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/order/get_buyer_invoice_info?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "queries": [
        {
            "order_sn": "220314U0G6UNMN"
        }
    ]
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: order_sn
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Shopee's unique identifier for an order.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: invoice_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Type of invoice requested: {1: personal, 2: company, 3: household}.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: invoice_detail
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Invoice info submitted by buyer. Might be masked, e.g. A****b, depending on order status.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer name (has value when invoice_type is personal, household, or company) - VN, TH, PH only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: email
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer email address (has value when invoice_type is personal and household) - VN, TH, PH only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: phone_number
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer phone number - TH only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: tax_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: has value when invoice_type is personal and household. - VN, TH, PH only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: address
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Buyer address in format "Street & number, city, zipcode, any additional info provided by buyer" (has value when invoice_type is personal and household) - PH, VN only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Same function as the address, only having a different field name for TH.Buyer address in format "Street & number, city, zipcode, any additional info provided by buyer" (only has value when invoice_type is personal).
